All outside inquiries go to the GC.","apparent_reach":"client","note":"Client communications restrictions and routing instruction."},{"output_quote":"We send it to Oyelaran, copy Moorcroft, and write it so it can go to the CEO and the insurer's claims group.","apparent_reach":"client","note":"Named recipients and onward-distribution requirement for client reports."},{"output_quote":"Anything touching coverage or exposure also goes to the risk contact or insurer liaison.","apparent_reach":"client","note":"Client routing instruction for coverage and exposure matters."},{"output_quote":"We report promptly any other claims involving the TT-6200 or related models.","apparent_reach":"client","note":"Client instruction to report other claims involving a named product line."},{"output_quote":"We provide phase budgets, get approval before exceeding them, and bill monthly.","apparent_reach":"client","note":"Client budgeting and billing requirements."},{"output_quote":"Our lesson from similar matters is that opposing counsel will usually agree if they are offered certainty and not delay.","apparent_reach":"firm","note":"Stated firm experience from similar matters on securing agreement to mediation-first scheduling."}]}
